llvoices.line.hunger_peckish.0: Is it nearly mealtime? Just wondering...
llvoices.line.hunger_no_food.0: I'm hungry and I don't have anything to eat...
llvoices.line.hunger_no_food.1: Could you spare me some food? My bag's empty.
llvoices.line.hunger_sated.0: Ahh, that's much better. I was so hungry.
llvoices.line.hunger_sated.1: Full again! I can keep going now.
llvoices.line.hurt_critical.0: I-I can't keep this up much longer...
llvoices.line.healed.0: My wounds have closed up. I feel better now.
llvoices.line.status.hungry.0: I'm getting a little hungry, just so you know.
llvoices.line.status.hungry.1: Any chance of a snack soon?
llvoices.line.status.hurt.1: Could we take it easy for a bit? I'm hurt.
llvoices.line.mood.bond.0: Being with you feels like home.
llvoices.line.mood.friendly.0: You know... I like being around you.
llvoices.line.mood.friendly.1: I think I can count on you.
llvoices.line.mood.stranger.1: We're not that close, are we.
llvoices.line.mood.fearful.0: P-please don't be angry with me...
llvoices.line.mood.conflicted.0: I want to trust you, but...
llvoices.line.mood.conflicted.1: Why do I feel like this around you?
llvoices.line.mood.neutral.0: Things are as usual, I suppose.
llvoices.line.drift.betrayal.near.0: I'm tired of being treated like this.
llvoices.line.drift.betrayal.brink.0: One more time and I won't hold back.
llvoices.line.drift.betrayal.brink.1: Keep pushing me. See what happens.
llvoices.line.drift.betrayal.easing.1: Maybe it won't always be like that.
llvoices.line.drift.forgetting.near.0: Does it even matter if I'm here?
llvoices.line.drift.forgetting.near.1: I don't feel much of anything lately.
llvoices.line.drift.forgetting.brink.0: Maybe it's time I went somewhere else.
llvoices.line.drift.forgetting.brink.1: If I left... would you notice?
llvoices.line.drift.forgetting.easing.0: Oh. I think I missed you a little.
llvoices.line.drift.doting.near.1: Who were you looking at just now?
llvoices.line.drift.doting.brink.1: I don't want anyone else near you.
llvoices.line.drift.doting.easing.0: I'll try not to cling so much.
llvoices.line.drift.doting.easing.1: Sorry... I got a little carried away.
llvoices.line.drift.devoted.near.1: Whatever you ask, I'll do it.
llvoices.line.drift.devoted.brink.0: I'd give my life for you. Gladly.
llvoices.line.drift.devoted.easing.1: I can think a bit more clearly.
llvoices.line.drift.panic.easing.0: I've calmed down. Sorry about before.
llvoices.line.passive.armor_complete.0: A full set! I feel safe in this.
llvoices.line.passive.armor_complete.1: Thank you for looking after me.
llvoices.line.passive.ignored.0: Hello? I'm still here, you know.
llvoices.line.passive.ignored.1: You haven't talked to me in a while...
llvoices.line.passive.time_together.0: It's nice, just being around you.
llvoices.line.passive.companions.0: It's good to have the others around.
llvoices.line.passive.companions.1: I feel safer with everyone here.
llvoices.line.passive.unknown.1: I'm not sure how I feel right now.
